Gold demand proves resilient despite Q2 selloff as central banks return and Asian buying remains strong - WGC
items.summaryEn: (Kitco News) - The gold market continues to search for its footing following the sharp drop in the second quarter, its biggest quarterly decline in a decade. But while the gold market may be battered and bruised, the latest report from the World Gold Council shows it hasn't been broken. Despite the disappointing broader performance, the WGC's Gold Demand Trends report highlighted resilience through the second quarter, with steady investment demand, a sharp rebound in central bank buying, and continued strength across Asia helping offset weakness in jewelry consumption and ETF outflows. The WGC said total gold demand, including over-the-counter (OTC) transactions, was unchanged year over year at 1,269 tonnes in the second quarter. First-half demand reached 2,522 tonnes, up 2% from the same period last year, while the value of that demand surged to a record $380 billion, underscoring gold's resilience even after prices retreated from January's record highs.

Gold and silver options now trading on Binance crypto platform
items.summaryEn: (Kitco News) – Binance, the world’s largest and most liquid digital assets exchange, has added U.S. dollar-denominated precious metals options to its commodity product suite. “Commodity Options are now live: USDT- settled, European-style contracts built on Binance’s proven Options infrastructure,” the exchange announced on Wednesday, adding that new options contracts enable users to “trade gold and silver with the same speed and simplicity as crypto options.” The new commodity options contracts are part of Binance’s growing TradFi (traditional finance) product suite, and the company said they offer traders “a new way to express direction, trade volatility, and hedge” from their Binance account.
